craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vīra of sealing — girt-am → nectar-life → eightfold-circle → seals-all → loosed-called → draught-dwells → moment-rises → effortless-all; the treatise seals effortless. Eightfold-warded circle; finest-splits; lords-led. Rejected: (a) eight→many → killed: eight counts. Read aloud: YOURS — SOUND-mass-BOD-ied … BHAI-ra-va, WORLD-lords-LED.

lines: Yours — sound-mass-bodied, eightfold-warded — outer circle just;
by finest splits and finer, Bhairava, world-lords-led.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tava śabdarāśivapuṣaḥ pratyaṣṭakam eva bāhyaparivāraḥ parasūkṣmādivibhedād bhairava lokeśvarapramukhāḥ

reads_against.argmap: What retinue outside? → Sound-bodied eightfold outer-led retinue.
c1_essence: Sealed all delighted throng by fullness-shown.
Conquering draught dwells clearly; stain known.
In-me flashing sealed; rite complete effortless.
